name: Sector / topic pill tabs (legacy)
purpose: Lets visitors pick their industry or topic from a row of pills and see a matching preview (one hero image, or a row of course cards).
description: Legacy-theme block with a `variant` prop producing two different shapes. 'industries' (/lms/solutions, theme green, rendered with id="industries" as the sticky-tabs 5th anchor target): centred serif H2 + grey paragraph, a wrapping row of pill tabs, then one full-width image pane with a bottom gradient, the selected tab name as a large serif label and a theme button. 'topics' (/content, theme yellow): side-hairline frame, eyebrow + H2, a row of 8px/0-radius tag tabs, then a row of 5 topic cards (portrait image + serif title; hover shows a frame and pattern) and an 'All Topics' button. <=767 cards wrap to 3-up, <=479 2-up and tab pills grow to fill rows.
